_comment: Merge this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude Code global settings). It registers the full local Verus DataQuad recording pipeline: UserPromptSubmit -> affect-capture reminder (non-force); Stop -> Present Experience record + affect-read enqueue; SessionStart -> affect-drain nudge (non-force, surfaces the pending count). All three are scope-gated to AEGIS drives in the scripts. Machine-specific: adjust the python.exe path and the .claude\hooks path to the account this runs under.
